description: Manually curated observations fed to the Hidden-Stress Gap (Phase 2C) and Sector Heat Map (Phase 3). Each row MUST carry a verified=true flag AND a non-empty HTTPS source_url to appear on the site. Any row missing either is filtered out at render time by src/data/manualInputs.ts.

render_guard.rule: verified === true && source_url starts with https://
render_guard.rationale: Several numbers in the spec came through secondary reporting. Nothing goes on the page without a primary-source URL and an explicit human verification. The guard trips automatically — no manual review step needed.

fitch_pc_default_ttm_overall.label: Fitch US Private Credit Default Rate, trailing 12 months (overall)

fitch_pc_default_ttm_by_sector.label: Fitch US Private Credit Default Rate, TTM, by sector

sp_large_co_bankruptcies_monthly.label: S&P Global Market Intelligence — US large-company bankruptcy filings, monthly count

sp_large_co_bankruptcies_by_sector.label: S&P Global Market Intelligence — bankruptcy filings by sector, period total

moody_hy_default_ttm.label: Moody's US High Yield Default Rate (issuer-weighted TTM)

moody_leveraged_loan_default_ttm.label: Moody's US Leveraged Loan Default Rate (issuer-weighted TTM)

epiq_commercial_ch11_monthly.label: Epiq AACER — Commercial Chapter 11 filings, monthly count

observations.notes: Template row — populate with a primary-source observation, set verified: true, and the row will appear in the Hidden-Stress Gap. Leave this template row in place as a reference for future edits.
Template row. `sector` is a free-text label matched against the sector heat map rows (e.g., 'healthcare_providers', 'industrials_manufacturing', 'consumer_discretionary', 'software').
Template row. Monthly count of US large-company bankruptcy filings per S&P Global Market Intelligence.
Template row. `period_label` labels the aggregation window (e.g., 'H1 2026', 'FY 2026').
